question: Can bandwidth alone make job-0, a 128-chip gang, placeable in the existing degraded local torus?

topology.physical_mapping: hypothetical; not a calibrated H100 fabric

workload.accelerator_label: H100-SXM parameters in pinned model only

model.identity: Pin every repository, input/config hash, runtime, seed, profile and accounting version. Output hash is not authentication.

model_inapplicable.tenant_isolation: synthetic single-tenant geometry only; no real isolation claim

checks.rule: Invalid/fail required checks refuse. Missing/stale/not_run required checks are incomplete. Mandatory inapplicable is incomplete unless a different reviewed profile declares it truly inapplicable. Preserve all gaps alongside failures.

freshness.model: Immutable pinned inputs do not age into measurements. Verify bytes at each run; any changed code/inputs invalidates previous comparison identity.
freshness.execution: No action until each mandatory evidence item has an approved finite TTL or validity window. At dispatch, now < valid_until; future/unknown timestamps, scope mismatch and observed drift block. Revalidate after queue delay. No snapshot implies reservation.

synthetic_freshness_tests.boundary: age < 60 valid, age >= 60 stale; illustrative contract fixture only

cpu_executor_proposal.proof: B only; not derived from model proof A
cpu_executor_proposal.scheduler: kind/Kubernetes proposed in delivery plan, prerequisites unverified
cpu_executor_proposal.applicability: CPU submission/identity/attempt/observation mechanics only. No GPU, thermal, checkpoint or operator-performance claim.

action_intent.model_request_reference: job-0 is a model referent only, not a runnable workload
action_intent.reservation_guarantee: not_requested; unsupported guarantees must be refused

approval.semantics: Single bound intent, no use at or after expiry; effective expiry is minimum of approval expiry and all mandatory evidence expiries. Unknown expiry blocks. Changed binding requires new evaluation/permission.

output_meanings.not_admitted_gpu_h: All unallocated nominal chips for full 720 h, including initially unhealthy, stranded and power-denied; not all healthy idle capacity.
output_meanings.recovery_and_discard_gpu_h: Allocated nominal minus retained recovery time; owns checkpoint/restart/discard once.
output_meanings.retained_communication_and_bubble_gpu_h: Retained runtime minus compute; includes communication, pipeline bubbles and synchronization wait.
output_meanings.useful_compute_gpu_h: Modeled retained compute service including recomputation, not completed training or tokens.
output_meanings.rough_memory_pass: Estimate below configured GB; does not establish runtime fit.
output_meanings.comparison: Fixed denominator, window, workload, source/model version, seeds and accounting; only declared intervention fields differ.

prohibited_inferences: smaller gang implies equivalent training work
